run_hydra_config_test: run the test_hydra_configs function to register habitat configs and execute a training experiment
compose_hydra_cfg: compose a Hydra DictConfig with habitat baselines RL overrides using my_app_compose_api
register_hydra_plugin: register the HabitatConfigPlugin so habitat task configs can be used with Hydra compose
execute_exp_train: execute an experiment with the composed config in train mode using execute_exp
print_cfg_yaml: print the composed Hydra config as YAML using OmegaConf.to_yaml for inspection
